title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30381: expose page sender to filter subscribers
summary: The OnRefreshPageOnAfterSetItemFilters event now exposes the page sender, allowing extensions to access page filters during item availability calculations without replacing standard behavior.
key_points: Extensions can now receive the page sender parameter in the OnRefreshPageOnAfterSetItemFilters event
Enables subscribers to read custom page-extension filters before availability calculations run
Maintains standard availability calculation behavior while providing extensibility
Applies to the Item Availability by BOM Level page
quote: Extensions need access to page 5871 so they can transfer custom page filters to the item record used by availability calculations.
